content.overview: Cognizance is BNSS s. 210 (old CrPC 190). Sessions discharge / charge: ss. 250–251 (old 227–228). Warrant-case discharge / charge on police report: ss. 262–263 (old 239–240). Charge to be framed within a taught 60-day clock from first hearing on charge — confirm Bare Act.
